title: Extension Mechanism
text: setStarvation() sets three pieces one call: Passing starv_coef = 0 reverses change: removes "starvation" entry other_mort, removes starv_coef column species_params, removes "mizerStarvation" params@extensions. projection, time step species size class, mizer calls starvMort(): function: Calls standard mizer function getEReproAndGrowth() get energy available growth reproduction, \(E_r(w)\), current community state. Computes starvation mortality rate \[\mu_s(w) = \frac{-E_r(w)}{w} \times \texttt{starv\_coef}\] size classes energy balance negative (\(E_r < 0\)). Sets mortality zero size classes positive energy balance. result species--size matrix dimensions initialN(params), getMort() adds mortality terms.
code: params <- setStarvation(params, starv_coef = 10) starvMort <- function(params, n, n_pp, n_other, ...) {     e <- getEReproAndGrowth(params, n = n, n_pp = n_pp, n_other)     mu_s <- -t(t(e * params@species_params$starv_coef) / params@w)     mu_s[e > 0] <- 0     return(mu_s) }

text: starvation mortality long energy income rate \(E_r\) positive. details rate see mizer::getEReproAndGrowth(). rate negative, per-capita mortality proportional rate inversely proportional body weight (therefore also lipid reserves): $$\mu_s(w) = \frac{-E_r(w)}{w} {\tt starv\_coeff} $$ proportionality constant starv_coeff set setStarvation().

title: Set starvation mortality. — setStarvation
text: params MizerParams object starv_coef Proportionality constant starvation mortality. default starv_coef = 10, effect instantaneous starvation mortality (1/year) 1 energy deficit 10% body weight. starv_coef = 0 starvation mortality. can set different value species providing vector length equal number species model.
